subject: csoai-automated-machine

the_machine.one_sentence: Every reader produces ≤4KB signed cards → every card carries a product block → all cards flow into one feed → one x402 gateway meters the paid fields → one attribution layer tells us which surface pays.
the_machine.chain: READERS → CARDS → SIGN → ANCHOR → PUBLISH → FEED → x402 GATEWAY → REVENUE

phase_1_now.name: READERS (what runs on cron)
phase_1_now.what: 17 readers, all permissionless, all free data sources

readers.name: velocity
readers.source: XRPL transfer logs + ETH Transfer events

phase_2_cards.name: CARDS (≤4KB, product block)
phase_2_cards.rule: free_fields always enough to quote and cite (distribution). paid_fields are the resolution people pay for (proofs). Data free, proofs paid — schema-enforced.

phase_3_sign_anchor.name: SIGN → ANCHOR (the trust chain)
phase_3_sign_anchor.anchor_ots: ✅ SUBMITTED (alice+bob calendars, waiting for Bitcoin block)
phase_3_sign_anchor.when_all_anchored: The card says: 'this existed at this time and no one — including CSOAI — can backdate it.' That's the premium tier.

free.what: Every card's free_fields, daily, RSS + JSON + pages

proof.what: Any single card's paid_fields, on demand

feed.what: Full firehose: all fields, all families, history, alerts

phase_5_gateway.name: x402 GATEWAY (the till)
phase_5_gateway.how: 9 doors collapse into one gateway that reads the card's product block and meters accordingly
phase_5_gateway.attribution: referrer tag per surface (MCP_REGISTRY, AWESOME_MCP, GLAMA, DIRECT, PROMOTION)
phase_5_gateway.settlement: USDC on Base, facilitator-verified, receipt issued
phase_5_gateway.dashboard: yield per family per week. Kill what doesn't yield, double what does.

phase_6_425_stablecoins.name: THE 425-STABLECOIN EXPANSION
phase_6_425_stablecoins.expansion: Index all 425 cheaply (DefiLlama API, free). Deep-measure top 20 (per-chain totalSupply(), attestation comparison). Cards for all.
phase_6_425_stablecoins.automation: DefiLlama API → normalize → claim-vs-reality diff → silence_days / gap_bps / staleness → card → sign → anchor → publish
phase_6_425_stablecoins.revenue: Free: total supply + staleness. Paid: per-chain splits, gap bps, alerts. Feed: $199/mo firehose.
phase_6_425_stablecoins.timeline: Week 1: top 20 deep. Week 2: all 425 indexed. Week 3: alerts on depegs/staleness.

what_happens_when_root_anchored.ots: Root hash appears in Bitcoin block. Verifiable by anyone with the .ots proof file. 'This measurement existed at Bitcoin block N.'
what_happens_when_root_anchored.rekor: Root hash in Sigstore transparency log (2.67B entries). Software supply chain world trusts this. 'Our measurements are in the same log as npm/pip/Go packages.'
what_happens_when_root_anchored.xrpl_memo: Root hash on XRPL ledger. $0.00001 cost. 'This measurement was published on XRPL ledger N.'
what_happens_when_root_anchored.combined: Triple-anchored: Bitcoin + Sigstore + XRPL. No one — including CSOAI — can backdate. That's the premium tier regulators and courts care about.
what_happens_when_root_anchored.revenue_impact: Anchored proofs sell at premium ($0.50-8 vs $0.01-0.25 unanchored). The anchor IS the product upgrade.

the_flywheel.step_6: More measurement = more cards = more authority
the_flywheel.compound: Every receipt anchors to the log. Every customer deepens the moat. Every new stablecoin/asset/rail = new section in the feed, not a new product.

honest_sentence: The machine: 17 readers on cron → ≤4KB signed cards → one feed → one x402 gateway → one attribution layer. Free distribution, paid proofs, $199/mo firehose. When the root is triple-anchored (OTS+Rekor+XRPL), the premium tier opens. 425 stablecoins indexed cheaply, top 20 deep-measured. Every new measurement = new SKU = zero new infrastructure.
